blockers_format_valid=true. Every task has a ### Blockers section holding either 'None' (T-001, T-002, T-005, T-009) or a comma-separated T-NNN list. No ranges and no prose.

REQ-001 is covered by T-003. REQ-002 by T-004 and T-012. REQ-003 by T-005 to T-009. REQ-005 by T-001 and T-011. REQ-006 by T-002 and T-013. REQ-007 by T-008 and T-010. REQ-004 has no task and is deferred with rationale in traceability.md (Deferred section and REQ-004 Clause Mapping). REQ-009 is Epic A1's external requirement and appears in traceability.md as N/A with a stated reason.

Every AC-001..AC-043 is claimed by a task's Requirements field, except AC-013, AC-017 and AC-029. Those three are listed in traceability.md 'Deferred / Non-Task Acceptance Criteria' with stated rationale. The Acceptance Mapping table gives a task for every other AC.
All 13 tasks (T-001..T-013) reference at least one REQ-NNN in Requirements.

The test-titled tasks are T-006 and T-007 (titles contain 'TEST-018' and 'TEST-019' and 'tests/'), T-008 ('assertions inside TEST-018/TEST-019') and T-012 ('test'). Each cites AC IDs: T-006 AC-022..AC-026 and AC-032, T-007 AC-010 and AC-019..AC-027, T-008 AC-004, AC-021, AC-036 and AC-037, T-012 AC-031.

This is a post-implementation provenance re-review; the Done and Implementation Complete statuses show it, though the task statement does not declare it, so I applied the lifecycle-validity rule. Status values are Done, In Progress, Implementation Complete and Planned, all in the allowed set. Approval is 'Approved (sudo 2026-08-08T16:33:11Z)' on T-001..T-012. T-013 carries bare 'Approved', which the lifecycle rule permits, and traceability.md Final Status records its source as the human approval in commit c4d66648. No approval value is outside the lifecycle-valid set.

workflow_match_precheck=PASS. All tasks declare Risk and Required Workflow, and the pairings match the matrix. Medium tasks (T-001, T-003, T-006, T-007) use acceptance-first. High tasks (T-002, T-004, T-005, T-008..T-013) use tdd.

The only AC claimed by two tasks is AC-026, in T-006 (TEST-018 successful done-transition assertion) and T-007 (TEST-019 assertion). The Done When text of each names its own suite, and the traceability.md Acceptance Mapping records the split as 'own share'. Every other AC has exactly one task.
All Blockers references (T-001..T-013) exist in the dependency-graph.json nodes array, which has 13 nodes.

BLOCKERS-FORMAT passed. In dependency-graph.json all edges point from higher-numbered or later-chain tasks to earlier ones. T-013 depends on T-002, T-003, T-004 and T-010. T-011 depends on T-013 and on every other task. No task depends back on T-011 or T-013, and T-010 does not depend on T-013. No cycle exists.

Each task has one coherent concern. T-008 groups three Epic A5 deferred fixture assertions, and T-010 holds the manifest, its evaluator and the SKIP re-pointing. T-002 holds the capture and promote scripts and the initial baseline. T-011 was already split into T-011 and T-013 for SINGLE-CONCERN.

The Done When items name concrete artifacts, suites and evidence: RED/GREEN TDD evidence, hash locks, an independent quality-gate verdict, and suite registration in run-all. One flagged item exists in precheck frozen_artifact_done_when: T-004 (line 695). It is satisfiable without editing a frozen artifact, because it names the implementation report or the specs/epic-195-a7-compatibility/verification/T-004/ addendum and states 'without modifying frozen traceability.md'. It is covered by a human-authorized WFI-004 amendment dated 2026-10-04. Advisory only: other tasks use 'traceability.md updated with T-NNN → REQ-NNN (AC-…)'. The detector did not flag these. They are satisfiable because the Task Mapping rows already exist in traceability.md and the status cell is normalized, so they need no body edit. T-011's 'confirmed to match' item names concrete observables: ASSERT cells have passing cases, SKIP cells read from T-010's manifest, N/A cells have no case.

The traceability.md Task Mapping covers T-001..T-013. The requirement IDs in traceability.md (REQ-001..REQ-007 and REQ-009) all appear in requirements.md; REQ-009 appears as Epic A1's external requirement cited in Field Definitions and AC-019. Layer Spec cells cite canonical anchors that exist in the layer documents: infra-spec.md#cicd-sequence and #data-residency-and-retention, security-spec.md#trust-boundaries, frontend-spec.md#technology-stack. REQ-004 and REQ-009 carry reasoned 'N/A — cross-layer only' values.
